property.description: Location, Location, Location.  If you are looking for secluded property close to the mountains this is it.  270  acres of undeveloped property in Madison County that attaches to the Shenandoah National Park close  to camp Hoover! Property is wooded with wildlife and mountain views. Build your vacation retreat or commute from this elevated land, with much to offer!!Located close to some of the best stocked rivers for fishing in the  state.,  There is a stream through property. Property has expansive road frontage on quaker run road  Easement for driveway  in front!  Property is in conservation easement, information located in documents.
